paragraphs: Unless the context otherwise indicates or requires, as used in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, the terms "we," "our," "us," "ADS" and the "Company" refer to Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. and its directly- and indirectly-owned subsidiaries as a combined entity, except where it is clear that the terms mean only Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc. exclusive of its subsidiaries. The term "Infiltrator" refers to Infiltrator Water Technologies, LLC, our wholly-owned subsidiary.

ADS is the leading manufacturer of innovative water management solutions in the stormwater and onsite wastewater industries, providing superior drainage solutions to manage the world's most precious resource: water. Our innovative products are used across a broad range of end markets and applications, including residential, non-residential, infrastructure and agriculture applications. We have established a leading position in many of these end markets by leveraging our national sales and distribution platform, market share model, industry-acclaimed engineering support, overall product breadth and scale plus manufacturing excellence. Our best-in-class product portfolio, go-to-market strategy and material conversion strategy helped drive consistent above market growth.

On February 2, 2026, we completed the acquisition of National Diversified Sales ("NDS"). NDS is a leading designer and manufacturer of residential stormwater and drainage solutions focused on managing surface and subsurface water around homes. NDS develops durable, easy‑to‑install products that help homeowners and contractors control runoff, prevent water damage, and protect landscapes and foundations. This combination brings together complementary water management solutions to expand our offerings. By adding NDS' expertise in residential water management solutions, access boxes and irrigation to our product portfolio, we further enhance our capabilities as a comprehensive provider of full-scale water management solutions.

We believe the ADS brand has long been associated with quality products and market-leading performance. Our trademarked green stripe, which is prominently displayed on many of our products, serves as clear identification of our commitment to the customers and markets we serve, and fortifies our brand recognition and presence. Our approach to water management is to manage the lifecycle of a raindrop from the moment water hits the ground until it is released back into the ecosystem. The ADS product portfolio is built around four steps of this lifecycle: Capture, Conveyance, Storage, and Treatment. ADS solutions safely and efficiently manage stormwater with environmentally friendly products. We believe we are the only water management solutions company that manages stormwater from when the rain first hits the ground until the moment it is returned to lakes and streams.

We estimate that the stormwater industry, including landscape irrigation, annually, is an approximately $14 billion industry. We estimate that the onsite wastewater market is a roughly $2 billion industry and that approximately 30% of new North American single-family homes utilize onsite wastewater systems. On a combined basis, we estimate that we have an addressable market opportunity of approximately $16 billion.

For a discussion of segment and geographic information, see "Note 20. Business Segment Information" to our audited consolidated financial statements included in "Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" of this Form 10-K.

Following the acquisition of NDS, we realigned our reportable segments to align with the manner in which the Chief Operating Decision Maker ("CODM") assesses performance and makes resource allocation decisions (the "Segment Realignment"). Our revised reportable segments consist of Stormwater and Wastewater (formerly referred to as the "Infiltrator" reportable segment). Further, we changed the measure used to evaluate segment profitability from adjusted gross profit to Adjusted EBITDA.

Segment results for the historical periods presented in these consolidated financial statements have been recast to reflect these changes. The Segment Realignment had no impact on our previously reported consolidated net sales, income from operations, net income attributable to ADS or earnings per share. These segments are described in greater detail in "Note 20. Business Segment Information" to our audited consolidated financial statements included in "Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data" of this Form 10-K.

As illustrated in the charts below, we provide a broad range of high performance thermoplastic corrugated pipe and related water management products to a highly diversified set of end markets and geographies.

We design, manufacture and market a complete line of high performance thermoplastic corrugated pipe and related water management products for use in a wide range of end markets. Our product line includes stormwater and wastewater management solution products. Stormwater products are designed as an integrated, end-to-end solution set which provides a comprehensive approach to managing stormwater from the moment it hits the ground until it is cleaned and returned to its natural environment. Stormwater products include single, double and triple wall corrugated polypropylene and polyethylene pipe ("Pipe"); a variety of additional water management products ("Allied Products"), including storm retention/detention and onsite wastewater chambers ("Chambers"); polyvinyl chloride drainage structures ("Structures"); fittings ("Fittings"); water quality filters and separators ("Water Quality"); and NDS channel drains, catch basins and access boxes; and various complementary products distributed through resale agreements, including geotextile products, drainage grates and other products. Wastewater products (formerly referred to as "Infiltrator") include plastic leachfield
chambers and systems, onsite wastewater tanks and accessories. The table below summarizes the percentage of Net Sales for Stormwater and Wastewater.

Our products and engineering project designs have been continuously and frequently recognized by the industry. This includes being honored many times during the past decade as the Plastics Pipe Institute's Project of the Year. We have won numerous awards from organizations such as the American Society of Testing & Materials ("ASTM"), the American Society of Civil Engineers, and many others.

Dual Wall Corrugated Pipe - Our N-12 pipe is a dual wall high-density polyethylene ("HDPE") pipe with a corrugated exterior for strength and a smooth interior wall for hydraulics and flow capacity. Our N-12 pipe competes in the storm sewer and drainage markets that are also served by concrete pipe. Our N-12 pipe is available in a wide range of diameters and sections of length. N-12 provides joint integrity, with integral bell and spigot joints for fast push-together installations and is sold either with watertight or soil-tight coupling and fitting systems. Our corrugated polyethylene pipe offers many benefits including ease of installation, job site handling and resistance to corrosion and abrasion. Corrugated pipe can easily be cut or coupled together, providing precise laying lengths while minimizing installation waste and difficulty.

headings: Risks Relating to Our Business
Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc

Demand for our products and services could decrease if we are unable to compete effectively, and our success depends largely on our ability to convert current demand for competitive products into demand for our products.
We may be affected by global climate change or by legal, regulatory or market responses to such change.
Our results of operations could be adversely affected by the effects of weather.
The loss of any of our significant customers could adversely affect our business.
Because our business is working capital intensive, we rely on our ability to manage our supply purchasing and customer credit policies.
Conducting a portion of our operations through joint ventures exposes us to risks and uncertainties, many of which are outside of our control.
We may not be able to successfully expand into new products.
We continue to invest in our initiatives. If we fail to implement these initiatives as expected, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be adversely affected.
Internally manufacturing our products at our own facilities subjects our business to risks associated with manufacturing processes and supply chain disruption.
The nature of our business exposes us to construction defect and product liability claims as well as other legal proceedings.
Cybersecurity incidents may threaten our confidential information, disrupt operations and result in harm to our reputation and adversely impact our business and financial performance.
Our success depends upon our ability to control labor costs and to attract, train and retain highly qualified employees and key personnel.
If we are unable to protect our intellectual property rights, or we infringe on the intellectual property rights of others, our ability to compete could be negatively impacted.
We could incur significant costs in complying with environmental, health and safety laws or permits or as a result of satisfying any liability or obligation imposed under such laws or permits.
Risks Relating to Our Acquisition of NDS
We may be unable to successfully integrate our and NDS' businesses in order to realize the anticipated benefits of the acquisition or do so within the intended timeframe.

Uncertainties associated with our acquisition of NDS may cause a loss of management personnel and other key employees, which could adversely affect our future business, operations and financial results.

Our results after our acquisition of NDS may suffer if we do not effectively manage our expanded operations following the acquisition or the business of NDS may underperform relative to our expectations.
Risks Relating to Our Indebtedness

Our level of indebtedness could adversely affect our business, financial conditions or results of operations and prevent us from fulfilling our obligations under the agreements governing the terms of our indebtedness.
Risks Relating to Our Common Stock
Future sales of shares by existing stockholders could cause our stock price to decline.
Anti-takeover provisions in our charter documents and Delaware law could discourage, delay or prevent a change in control of us and may affect the trading price of our common stock.
General Risk Factors

As a publicly-traded manufacturing company, we are subject to a variety of risks in addition to the risks described above, each of which could adversely affect our financial position, results of operations or cash flows.
paragraphs: Please carefully consider the risks described below, together with all other information included or incorporated by reference in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be materially adversely affected. In these circumstances, the market price of our common stock could decline significantly.

Fluctuations in the price and availability of resins, our principal raw materials, new tariff policies and our inability to obtain adequate supplies of resins from suppliers and pass on resin price increases to customers could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

Resin prices fluctuate substantially as a result of changes in crude oil and natural gas prices, changes in existing processing capabilities and the capacity of resin suppliers. Polypropylene resin suppliers are limited, high-density polyethylene suppliers are geographically concentrated, and supply of recycled resin is also limited. Supply interruptions could arise from disruptions to existing petrochemical capacity and recycled resin sources caused by labor disputes and shortages, weather conditions or natural disasters affecting supplies or shipments, transportation disruptions or other factors beyond our control. An extended disruption in the timely availability of raw materials from our key suppliers would result in a decrease in our revenues and profitability. Additionally, our customers' production schedules could be impacted by these shortages, which could result in reduced sales of our products.

Inflation in these raw material costs could also result in significant cost increases, further affecting our business. Our ability to maintain profitability heavily depends on our ability to pass through to our customers any increase in raw material costs. If increases in the cost of raw materials or any potential tariffs cannot be passed on to our customers, our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows will be adversely affected. Conversely, in the event that there is deflation, we may experience pressure from our customers to reduce prices. We may not be able to reduce our cost base to offset any such price concessions which could adversely impact our results of operations and cash flows.

Any disruption or volatility in general business and economic conditions in the markets in which we operate, including market uncertainty and volatility, could have a material adverse effect on the demand for our products and services.

The markets in which we operate are sensitive to regional, U.S. and worldwide economic conditions, including availability of credit, interest rates, inflation, tariffs or other trade policies, fluctuations in capital and business and consumer confidence. •Adjusted EBITDA increased 8.3% to $962.9 million •Cash provided by operating activities increased $237.6 million to $819.1 million
•Free cash flow increased $200.7 million to $569.3 million

Net sales increased $146.1 million, or 5.0%, to $3,050.4 million, as compared to $2,904.2 million in the prior year. Stormwater sales increased $71.0 million, or 3.1%, to $2,397.4 million. Wastewater sales increased $75.1 million, or 13.0%, to $653.0 million.

Gross profit increased $73.1 million, or 6.7%, to $1,167.4 million as compared to $1,094.2 million in the prior year. The increase in gross profit is primarily driven by favorable volume, price/cost and mix of construction market and Infiltrator sales, partially offset by unfavorable fixed cost absorption as well as the mix impact from acquisitions.

Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP financial measure, increased $73.7 million, or 8.3%, to $962.9 million, as compared to $889.2 million in the prior year. The increase is primarily due to the factors mentioned above. As a percentage of net sales, Adjusted EBITDA was 31.6% as compared to 30.6% in the prior year.

paragraphs: 除非文意另有說明或要求，否則在本年度報告表10-K中，"we"、"our"、"us"、"ADS"及"the Company"所指為Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc.及其直接與間接擁有之子公司作為一體之組合，除非明確說明這些詞語僅指Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc.不包括其子公司。"Infiltrator"一詞指Infiltrator Water Technologies, LLC，為我們之 wholly-owned subsidiary。

ADS為美國雨水管理與現場污水處理產業中創新水管理解決方案之領導製造商，提供優越之排水解決方案以管理世界上最重要的資源：水。我們創新之產品應用於廣泛之終端市場與應用，包括住宅、非住宅、基礎建設與農業應用。我們透過我們全國銷售與分銷平台、市場佔有率模式、業界譽為卓越之工程支援、產品廣度與規模以及製造卓越性，在許多這些終端市場建立領導地位。我們最佳級產品組合、市場進入策略與材料轉換策略有助於驅動持續高於市場之成長。

我們於2026年2月2日完成對National Diversified Sales（"NDS"）之收購。NDS為美國住宅雨水與排水解決方案之領導設計與製造商，專注於管理住宅周圍之地表與地下水分。NDS開發耐用且易安裝之產品，協助屋主與承包商控制雨水流失、預防水損壞，並保護景觀與地基。此組合將補充性之水管理解決方案結合，以擴展我們之產品組合。透過將NDS在住宅水管理解決方案、接線箱與灌溉之專業知識加入我們之產品組合，我們進一步強化我們作為全面水管理解決方案供應商之能力。

我們相信ADS品牌長期與高品質產品與市場領導表現相關聯。我們註冊之綠色條紋，於許多產品上顯著展示，作為我們對服務客戶與市場之承諾之明確識別，並強化我們品牌之認知與存在。我們對水管理之方法為管理雨水滴之生命週期，從雨水觸地之時刻，直到其被釋放回生態系統。ADS產品組合建基於此生命週期之四個步驟：收集、導流、儲存與處理。ADS解決方案以環境友善產品安全且高效地管理雨水。我們相信我們為唯一一家從雨水首度觸地至其被回歸湖泊與溪流之水管理解決方案公司。
我們估計雨水管理產業，包括景觀灌溉，每年約為140億美元產業。我們估計現場污水處理市場為約20億美元產業，且約30%之北美單戶住宅使用現場污水處理系統。合計而言，我們估計我們之可接觸市場機會約為160億美元。
有關分部與地理資訊之討論，請參閱"附註20. 商業分部資訊"至我們經審計之合併財務報表，包含於本表10-K之"項目8. 財務報表與補充資料"中。

於收購NDS後，我們重新調整我們之應報告分部，以符合首席營運決策者（"CODM"）評估績效與做出資源配置決策之方式（"分部重新調整"）。我們之修正後應報告分部為雨水與污水（ formerly referred to as the "Infiltrator" reportable segment）。進一步地，我們改變用以評估分部獲利之衡量標準，從調整後毛利率轉為調整後營運資金（Adjusted EBITDA）。
歷史期間之分部結果已重新調整以反映這些變更。分部重新調整對我們先前報告之合併淨銷售額、營運收入、歸屬於ADS之淨收入或每股盈餘無影響。這些分部於"附註20. 商業分部資訊"中更詳細說明，包含於本表10-K之"項目8. 財務報表與補充資料"中之經審計合併財務報表。
如下列圖表所示，我們提供廣泛的高性能熱塑性波紋管及相關的水管理產品，應用於高度多樣化的終端市場與地理區域。

我們設計、製造及行銷一整套高性能熱塑性波紋管及相關的水管理產品，用於廣泛的終端市場。我們的產品線包括雨水與廢水管理解決方案產品。雨水管理產品被設計為一整套整合的端到端解決方案，提供從雨水接觸地面開始，直到清理並回歸自然環境為止的全面管理方法。雨水管理產品包括單層、雙層及三層波紋聚丙烯與聚乙烯管（"Pipe"）；多種額外的水管理產品（"Allied Products"），包括雨水儲存/暫存及現場廢水集水井（"Chambers"）；聚氯乙烯排水結構（"Structures"）；接頭（"Fittings"）；水質過濾器與分離器（"Water Quality"）；以及NDS渠道排水、集水井與通路箱；以及透過轉售協議分銷的各種補充產品，包括地紡織產品、排水蓋板及其他產品。廢水產品（先前稱為"Infiltrator"）包括塑料滲漏場、集水井與系統、現場廢水儲水槽與配件。下表總結了雨水與廢水的淨銷售額百分比。

本公司產品與工程設計計畫持續且頻繁地獲得業界認可。此包括在過去十年中多次榮獲塑膠管協會（Plastics Pipe Institute）年度計畫獎項。本公司亦獲得多項來自美國材料與試驗協會（"ASTM"）、美國土木工程師協會等機構的獎項。

雙壁波紋管 - 本公司N-12管為雙壁高密度聚乙烯（"HDPE"）管，外層為波紋結構以增加強度，內層為平滑壁面以提升水力性能與流動容量。本公司N-12管在雨水下水道與排水市場與混凝土管競爭，此市場亦由混凝土管服務。本公司N-12管提供廣泛的管徑與長度選擇。N-12管提供接頭完整性，具整體鐘形與插口接頭，可快速進行推接安裝，並可搭配防水或防土耦合系統銷售。本公司波紋聚乙烯管提供許多優點，包括安裝容易、工地操作簡便與抗腐蝕與磨損特性。波紋管可輕易切割或接合，提供精確的鋪設長度，同時減少安裝浪費與困難。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
Advanced Drainage Systems, Inc
若我們無法有效競爭，客戶對我們產品與服務的需求可能會減少，而我們的成功 largely 取決於我們將現有對競爭產品的需求轉化為對我們產品的需求之能力。
我們可能受到全球氣候變遷或對此變遷之法律、法規或市場反應的影響。
我們的營運成果可能因天氣因素而受到不利影響。
我們任何重要客戶之流失可能會對我們業務造成不利影響。
由於我們的業務為營運資金密集型，我們依賴我們管理供應鏈採購及客戶信用政策之能力。
透過合資企業進行部分營運會使我們面臨風險與不確定性，許多風險與不確定性為我們所無法控制。
我們可能無法成功拓展至新產品。
我們持續投資於我們的計畫。若我們未能如預期執行這些計畫，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
在自有廠區 internally manufacturing 我們的產品，使我們的業務面臨製造流程及供應鏈中斷相關風險。
我們的業務性質使我們面臨施工瑕疵及產品責任索償，以及其他法律程序的風險。
網路安全事件可能威脅我們的機密資訊，幹擾營運，並對我們的聲譽造成損害，進而對我們的業務及財務表現產生不利影響。
我們的成功取決於我們控制勞動成本的能力，以及吸引、培訓並留住高素質員工及關鍵人員的能力。
若我們無法保護我們的智慧財產權，或侵犯他人的智慧財產權，將可能對我們的競爭力產生負面影響。
我們可能因遵守環境、健康及安全法規或許可證，或因履行任何根據這些法規或許可證所施加的責任或義務而產生重大成本。
與本公司收購 NDS 有關的風險
本公司可能無法成功整合本公司與 NDS 的業務以實現收購預期的效益，或未能在預期時間內完成此整合。
與本公司收購 NDS 有關的不確定性，可能導致管理人員及其他關鍵員工流失，這可能會對本公司未來的業務、營運及財務結果產生不利影響。
本公司收購 NDS 後的結果，若未能有效管理擴充後的營運，或 NDS 的業務表現低於本公司預期，可能會受到不利影響。
與本公司負債有關的風險
本公司負債水平可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運結果產生不利影響，並可能使本公司無法履行根據負債條款所訂立之協議的義務。
與本公司普通股有關的風險
現有股東未來出售股份，可能導致本公司股票價格下跌。
本公司章程文件及特拉華州法律中的反收購條款，可能會抑制、延宕或防止本公司控制權的變更，並可能影響本公司普通股的交易價格。
一般風險因素
作為一家上市的製造公司，我們除上述所列風險外，還面臨多種其他風險，這些風險可能對我們的財務狀況、營運成果或現金流產生不利影響。
paragraphs: 請謹慎考量下列所描述的風險，並與本年度報告表10-K中所包含或參考的其他所有資訊一併考量。若任何下列風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與現金流造成重大不利影響。在這種情況下，本公司普通股的市場價格可能大幅下跌。
樹脂價格與可取得性波動、本公司主要原材料，新關稅政策以及本公司無法從供應商取得足夠的樹脂供應並將樹脂價格上漲轉嫁給客戶，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與現金流造成不利影響。

樹脂價格因原油與天然氣價格變動、現有加工能力變動以及樹脂供應商的供應能力而大幅波動。聚丙烯樹脂供應商有限，高密度聚乙烯樹脂供應商地理上集中，回收樹脂的供應也有限。供應中斷可能因勞動糾紛與人手不足、天氣條件或天然災害影響供應或運輸、運輸中斷或其他超出本公司控制範圍的因素而發生。若關鍵供應商的原材料供應出現長時間中斷，將導致本公司收入與獲利減少。此外，這些短缺可能影響客戶的生產排程，進而導致本公司產品銷售減少。

這些原材料成本的通貨膨脹也可能導致顯著的成本增加，進一步影響本公司業務。本公司維持獲利能力的能力很大程度取決於能否將原材料成本的增加轉嫁給客戶。若無法將原材料成本或任何潛在關稅的增加轉嫁給客戶，將對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與現金流造成不利影響。相反地，若發生通貨緊縮，我們可能面臨客戶要求降低價格的壓力。我們可能無法降低成本基礎以抵銷任何這樣的價格讓步，這可能會對營運結果與現金流造成不利影響。
任何對本公司營運市場之一般商業與經濟條件的幹擾或波動，包括市場不確定性與波動，都可能對本公司產品與服務的需求造成重大不利影響。
本公司營運的市場對區域性、美國與全球經濟條件敏感，包括信貸可取得性、利率、通貨膨脹、關稅或其他貿易政策、資本與商業與消費者信心的波動。這些市場與整體經濟的困難條件以多種方式影響本公司業務。例如：
